description: Is this school in MEXT's list of institutions eligible for Japan's tuition support system (tuition reduction, JASSO grants), since when, and did MEXT publish a revocation or notification for it? Give school_name (exact, width and spaces ignored) or school_code (F101110100010); prefecture, school_type, establishment narrow. Returns listed, no_longer_listed_since, not_found_in_checked_records or unknown, confirmed_on, published_notices (dates, URLs) and source. Confirm with the school and MEXT.

establishment.description: Establishment: national (国立), public (公立), private (私立)

prefecture.description: Prefecture of the main campus: Tokyo or 東京都, JIS code (13) or local government code (130001)

school_code.description: MEXT school code: one letter and 12 digits, e.g. F101110100010

school_name.description: School name in Japanese as published, e.g. 北海道大学 (width, spaces and symbols ignored; exact match, partial matches come back as candidates)

school_type.description: School type: university (大学), junior_college (短期大学), college_of_technology (高等専門学校), specialized_training_college (専門学校)

name: tuition_support_school_lookup

candidates.description: Partial-name candidates when no school has exactly this name. Not matches.

confirmed_on.description: MEXT's date of confirmation of the institutional requirements (YYYY-MM-DD).

listed.description: true = in the current version of MEXT's list.

location.description: Location of the main campus as published.

operator_name.description: Operator (setchisha) as published; null when it looks like a personal name (operator_withheld).

school_code.description: MEXT school code as published; null when MEXT shows the provisional code Z999999999999.

school_id.description: This service's id for the school (s-...): school code and school name together.

official_check.description: Read first: listed as published by MEXT on the date shown; eligibility for an individual student depends on the student's own requirements; confirm with the school and MEXT.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

effective_on.description: Effective date stated in a revocation publication.

published_notices.description: Confirmation revocations and notifications published by MEXT for this school name (published facts with dates and URLs; not an assessment). Null for list queries without a school name or code.

status.description: listed: A record matching the query by identifier or exact name is in the version of the official record checked (status_as_of). not_found_in_checked_records: No matching record in the version checked. It says nothing about other registries, other names or periods before tracking_since. no_longer_listed_since: A matching record was seen by this service earlier and is not in the current version since the date given. The reason is not published here and is not inferred. expired: The official record itself states an end or expiry date that has passed. The reason is not inferred. unknown: Could not be determined: not checked, data unavailable or stale, or only similar-name candidates were found (see unknown_reason).

registry_status.description: The common registry status section shared across this operator's servers. Null for list queries without a school name or code.

source.description: Where the answer comes from: MEXT page and file, the list's own as-of date, and when this service last fetched it.

status.description: listed = in the current list version; no_longer_listed_since = seen by this service in an earlier version, not in the current one (reason not stated by the list); not_found_in_checked_records = not in the current version nor among schools seen leaving it since tracking_since; unknown = list not loaded or stale, or only partial-name candidates (unknown_reason).

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.
